description: This PHP source file defines the 'StripeSubscriptionController' class responsible for handling Stripe webhook events related to subscription billing, invoice payments, and refunds within the Goteo application. It manages communication with Stripe's API, processes webhook events, updates investment statuses based on payment events, and creates new investment records when necessary.

classes.name: StripeSubscriptionController
classes.description: Controller class handling Stripe webhook events for subscriptions, payments, and refunds within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a StripeClient instance and an InvestRepository.

methods.name: subscriptionsWebhook
methods.description: Main webhook handler that processes incoming Stripe webhook events based on their type.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Handles refund events, retrieves the related invoice, and cancels associated investments.

methods.name: processInvoice
methods.description: Handles invoice payment events, updates or creates investment records based on the invoice details.
